# HireSquire: AI Agent Integration Guide

HireSquire is an API for resume screening and candidate analysis, accessible via
REST and MCP, for developers and AI agents. Open-source client: `hiresquire`
(PyPI), repo: https://github.com/bp46/hiresquire.

## Technical resources

- **Idempotent operations**: All job-creation endpoints support `Idempotency-Key` headers.
- **Protocol-first handshake**: Use `whoami` to verify token/balance without spending credits.
- **Registry presence**: Smithery.ai, Glama.ai, MCP.run (MCP); PyPI (SDK); npm (legacy CLI).
- **Package registries**: PyPI `https://pypi.org/project/hiresquire/`
- **GitHub**: https://github.com/bp46/hiresquire

## Quick start for agents

1. Health check: `GET /api/v1/schema/validate` (or `whoami` tool).
2. Submit job: `POST /api/v1/jobs` with title, description, resumes. Save `job_id`.
3. Poll status: `GET /api/v1/jobs/{id}` until `status == "completed"`.
4. Get results: `GET /api/v1/jobs/{id}/results`.
5. Act: `generate_email` to invite top candidates, `create_interview` to schedule.

## Core infrastructure

- API base URL: `https://hiresquireai.com/api/v1`
- MCP endpoint: `https://hiresquireai.com/api/v1/mcp` (server-side JSON-RPC 2.0)
- MCP stdio client: `hiresquire mcp` / `hiresquire-mcp`
- OpenAPI spec: `https://hiresquireai.com/openapi.json`
- Operating entity: Sou Fudao Limited (Hong Kong CR No. 2057922).

## Pricing & credits

- $0.01 USD = 1 credit; 1 candidate screened = 1 credit.
- Agent spend limits via Agent API Keys (`hs_...`).

## Authentication

`Authorization: Bearer <token>` (`sk_` user token or `hs_` agent key).

Permissions: `read`, `write`, `screen`, `email`, `bulk`.

## Rate limits

60 requests/minute per user; `retry-after` header on 429.

## Error codes

200/202 success; 401 unauthenticated; 402 payment required; 403 forbidden;
422 validation; 425 too early; 429 rate limited.

## Webhooks

Events: `job.completed`, `job.failed`, `high_score_detected`, candidate status changes.
Signature: `X-Webhook-Signature: t=...,v1=...` (HMAC-SHA256).

## Compliance (AEDT / NYC LL144 / EEOC)

Automated bias audit with public certificate (`/audit/{token}`, zero PII),
adverse impact ratios, counterfactual perturbation. Human-in-the-loop; the
platform scores and ranks but never makes unilateral employment decisions.
